business: Interlock — a fourteen-person company in Sheffield selling software that proves high-voltage switching schedules against a network model before anybody operates a switch. Its users are Senior Authorised Persons at distribution network operators and at large private HV networks, who write the numbered sequence of operations that makes a work area safe. Its commercial first step is a paid four-week pilot in which it models one of the customer's own substations and proves a schedule they have already written and approved.
